selection.rationale: With no prior strategy-local MACE outcomes available, this initial round uses a balanced Latin-like space-filling design across the nb_ta_o action space. Exactly 8 samples are allocated to each of the 8 compositions (Nb2O5, Ta2O5, NbTaO5, NbO2, TaO2, NbTaO4, Nb2O4, Ta2O4), evenly spanning all five size tiers (12 to 14 structures per tier across 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32), both generator classes (AFLOW and PyXtal prototypes and charge-compensated oxygen-vacancy generators), unstrained vs. 0.015-strained perturbations, and all three symmetry families (low-symmetry, orthorhombic, and high-symmetry) while strictly respecting shared group capacities.
